about.title: About The Rascon CPA Firm in Houston TX : Tax Accountant, Business Accounting & Consulting Firms, Quickbook & Bookkeeping Services
text: The Rascon CPA Firm PLLC is a firm founded by Melissa Rascon, CPA located in the heart of The Woodlands. Melissa is a highly experienced Tax Professional with over twenty years of experience in both public accounting and industry, and is dedicated to providing specialized tax planning, compliance, and consultation services for individuals and small and medium sized companies for both domestic and international tax related issues.

The firm’s primary goal in providing high quality services is to build relationships with our clients and business partners by having constant communication, being easily accessible, and being highly responsive. We thrive on educating them on the tax laws, building their accounting processes, maintaining their books, taking care of their payroll, and more importantly helping their business succeed in the most efficient way possible through a well linked network.

We also provide financial and tax due diligence services and internal control reviews to help our clients expand their business services and implement controls around their accounting processes to place safeguards that will dramatically reduce the risk of human error and fraud.
